title: 我为什么用 Fedora Server 做 NAS 系统
content: The author uses Fedora Server 44 as their NAS system because it aligns with their personal storage philosophy: no RAID redundancy, relying instead on full backups for irreplaceable data and keeping only indexes for replaceable content. They migrated from Windows Server 2025 in 2026, converting four data drives from NTFS to XFS after encountering Linux NTFS driver limitations. The system runs 14 containers via Podman (mostly rootless), provides Samba shares, and uses Xray tunnel plus frp for zero-exposure remote access without public ports. Key reasons for choosing Fedora Server include faster kernel updates, native Podman integration, SELinux enforcing by default, Cockpit management, and clean server edition without desktop bloat. The author emphasizes this path requires Linux proficiency, disciplined backup habits, and comfort with self-maintenance rather than vendor support.

The statistical watermark persists through copying and partial editing, while C2PA metadata tags generated files. title: AI正在吃光互联网，可我们快没东西喂它了
content: Cloudflare predicts AI internet traffic will exceed human traffic 1000-fold in five years. Meanwhile, publicly available text data for training language models may be exhausted by 2026-2032. Stack Overflow exemplifies this crisis: monthly questions dropped from 200,000 to under 50,000 since ChatGPT's launch, while 84% of developers now use AI tools daily. Top contributors are leaving, unanswered questions rising, and some developers visit solely to fix AI-generated errors. Research shows AI models degrade when trained recursively on AI-generated content—a "digital inbreeding" effect. The article warns of a potential spiral where reduced human knowledge production leads to poorer AI training data, further diminishing knowledge quality, while human supervisory capabilities atrophy through over-reliance on AI systems.

content: xAI's Imagine Image 2.0, promoted by Elon Musk, ranks second in text-to-image and image editing on the LMSYS arena. The tool excels at meme creation. However, strict content moderation limits its usability. title: OpenAI 代号为 Doug 的最新预训练大模型曝光
content: OpenAI is developing "Doug," its largest pretraining model to date, expected by November 2025. Since GPT-4o in May 2024, OpenAI relied on post-training improvements, but facing diminishing returns and competitor pressure, it resumed base model pretraining. Doug follows validation work on the "Garlic" model. Success would mark OpenAI's return to large-scale base pretraining, potentially advancing AI capabilities through its established reinforcement learning systems.
